_comment: GitHub Copilot CLI. INTENTIONALLY EMPTY, and not for want of research: Copilot does not bill tokens at all. A seat carries a monthly premium-request allowance (Pro 300, Pro+ 1500); each interaction spends allowance equal to the model's multiplier, and overage is $0.04 per premium request. Source: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/billing/copilot-requests (retrieved 2026-08-18). Filling this with the underlying vendors' per-token rates would invent a number no Copilot user is ever charged. Pricing Copilot honestly needs a request-denominated cost model this schema cannot express; until that exists, every Copilot model bills $0 via the table and is counted in unknown_model_events_total (P8-002).
